key: ???: Greetings, Trainer.
en: ???: Greetings, Trainer.
ja: ???: ごきげんよう トレーナー

key: Tell me something.
en: Tell me something.
ja: 一つ 教えてくださる?

key: Did you, as a citizen of this city, have any inkling of this place beneath it?
en: Did you, as a citizen of this city, have any inkling of this place beneath it?
ja: この街の住人として その下にこんな場所があると 察していまして?

key: ???: I suspect not.
en: ???: I suspect not.
ja: ???: おそらく 知らぬでしょう

key: After all, most people don't.
en: After all, most people don't.
ja: なにしろ たいていの者は 知りませんもの

key: They are ignorant to the centuries of history right beneath their calloused feet.
en: They are ignorant to the centuries of history right beneath their calloused feet.
ja: 荒れた足の下に 幾世紀もの歴史があることに 気づきもしない

key: And do you know, Trainer, what is beyond that gate?
en: And do you know, Trainer, what is beyond that gate?
ja: では トレーナー あの門の向こうに 何があるかご存じ?

key: I will tell you.
en: I will tell you.
ja: 教えて さしあげましょう

key: It is the very core of Reborn.
en: It is the very core of Reborn.
ja: リボーンの 核そのものです

key: This is a sacred place.
en: This is a sacred place.
ja: ここは 聖なる地

key: A place from where the world began.
en: A place from where the world began.
ja: 世界が 始まった場所

key: So tell me, Trainer.
en: So tell me, Trainer.
ja: では お聞かせ願いたい トレーナー

key: How insolent,
en: How insolent,
ja: どれほど 無礼で

key: How utterly ignorant,
en: How utterly ignorant,
ja: どれほど 愚かであれば

key: Must one be to build such a wretched city right over a precious holy land?
en: Must one be to build such a wretched city right over a precious holy land?
ja: 尊き聖地の真上に かような卑しい街を築けるのでしょう?

key: For THAT is Reborn:
en: For THAT is Reborn:
ja: それこそが リボーン

key: The city of insolence.
en: The city of insolence.
ja: 無礼の街

key: Ironically, they built it from the symbols of that which it occludes.
en: Ironically, they built it from the symbols of that which it occludes.
ja: 皮肉にも 覆い隠したものの象徴で 築かれている

key: Ruby, the seal of pain.
en: Ruby, the seal of pain.
ja: ルビー 痛みの印

key: Sapphire, the seal of love.
en: Sapphire, the seal of love.
ja: サファイア 愛の印

key: Emerald, the seal of faith.
en: Emerald, the seal of faith.
ja: エメラルド 信仰の印

key: And Amethyst, the seal of the beyond.
en: And Amethyst, the seal of the beyond.
ja: そして アメジスト 彼方の印

key: Each one is a key.
en: Each one is a key.
ja: それぞれが 鍵

key: When the four are brought together, Reborn's true power-- its sacred rite-- will be restored.
en: When the four are brought together, Reborn's true power-- its sacred rite-- will be restored.
ja: 四つがそろったとき リボーンの真の力——聖なる儀式が よみがえる

key: We will be rid of this malignant junkyard and beauty can be restored to the world.
en: We will be rid of this malignant junkyard and beauty can be restored to the world.
ja: この悪しきごみ捨て場を消し去り 世界に美を取り戻せるのです

key: You will walk away safely.
en: You will walk away safely.
ja: あなたは 無事に去ってよろしい

key: Your friend, too.
en: Your friend, too.
ja: お連れの方も ともに

key: She is here, and with Borealis gone, there's little point in keeping her.
en: She is here, and with Borealis gone, there's little point in keeping her.
ja: 彼女はここにいます。ボレアリスが消えた今 とどめておく意味もない

key: Do as you will to the fool guards who keep her.
en: Do as you will to the fool guards who keep her.
ja: 見張りの愚か者どもは 好きになさい

key: I have but one request:
en: I have but one request:
ja: ただ 一つだけ お願いが

key: When you leave, take this place with you.
en: When you leave, take this place with you.
ja: 去るときは この場所を 持ち帰りなさい

key: Share this place with the world.
en: Share this place with the world.
ja: この場所を 世に 伝えるのです

key: Remind them:
en: Remind them:
ja: そして 思い出させなさい

key: This world which they have undone will, itself, be their undoing.
en: This world which they have undone will, itself, be their undoing.
ja: 彼らが壊したこの世界こそが 彼ら自身を滅ぼすのだと

key: ASTER: Hey, what are you doing here?!
en: ASTER: Hey, what are you doing here?!
ja: アスター: おい なんでここにいるんだ?!

key: ECLIPSE: Obviously, he followed us...
en: ECLIPSE: Obviously, he followed us...
ja: エクリプス: どう見ても つけてきたのよ……

key: ECLIPSE: Obviously, she followed us...
en: ECLIPSE: Obviously, she followed us...
ja: エクリプス: どう見ても つけてきたのよ……

key: ECLIPSE: Obviously, they followed us...
en: ECLIPSE: Obviously, they followed us...
ja: エクリプス: どう見ても つけてきたのよ……

key: VICTORIA: \PN, is it really you?!
en: VICTORIA: \PN, is it really you?!
ja: ヴィクトリア: \PN 本当に あなたなの?!

key: ASTER: And the boss just walked right past you?!
en: ASTER: And the boss just walked right past you?!
ja: アスター: しかも ボスは お前の横を 素通りしたのか?!

key: ECLIPSE: Told you we shouldn't count on him for anything.
en: ECLIPSE: Told you we shouldn't count on him for anything.
ja: エクリプス: あの人を当てにするなって 言ったでしょう

key: So much for the "family"...
en: So much for the "family"...
ja: 「ファミリー」も 大したものね……

key: ASTER: Fine, we'll just have to capture you ourselves!
en: ASTER: Fine, we'll just have to capture you ourselves!
ja: アスター: いいさ オレたちの手で 捕まえてやる!

key: VICTORIA: I don't think so!
en: VICTORIA: I don't think so!
ja: ヴィクトリア: そうは させません!

key: ECLIPSE: You stay quiet, missy.
en: ECLIPSE: You stay quiet, missy.
ja: エクリプス: お嬢さんは 黙ってて

key: VICTORIA: Make me!
en: VICTORIA: Make me!
ja: ヴィクトリア: 黙らせてみなさい!

key: Uh... what just happened?
en: Uh... what just happened?
ja: えっと……今　何が起きたんスか?

key: ...Are you kidding me.
en: ...Are you kidding me.
ja: ……冗談でしょう

key: ECLIPSE: Seriously, who let her keep her Pokémon?!
en: ECLIPSE: Seriously, who let her keep her Pokémon?!
ja: エクリプス: ちょっと 誰がポケモンを持たせたままにしたの?!

key: ASTER: I didn't even think about it...
en: ASTER: I didn't even think about it...
ja: アスター: 考えもしなかった……

key: VICTORIA: I've had them the whole time!
en: VICTORIA: I've had them the whole time!
ja: ヴィクトリア: ずっと 持っていましたよ!

key: Borealis never took them from me.
en: Borealis never took them from me.
ja: ボレアリスは 取り上げませんでした

key: He told me to keep them and wait for the right moment.
en: He told me to keep them and wait for the right moment.
ja: 持っておいて 頃合いを待てと 言われたんです

key: I've been training in secret for this moment this whole time!
en: I've been training in secret for this moment this whole time!
ja: この時のために ずっと隠れて鍛えてきました!

key: ECLIPSE: Ohhh my god.
en: ECLIPSE: Ohhh my god.
ja: エクリプス: ……もう 最悪

key: Even after death, the old man is a pain in our necks.
en: Even after death, the old man is a pain in our necks.
ja: 死んだ後まで あの老人は 厄介ね

key: VICTORIA: ...Even after what?
en: VICTORIA: ...Even after what?
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……死んだ 後?

key: ECLIPSE: Forget it, just go.
en: ECLIPSE: Forget it, just go.
ja: エクリプス: 忘れて。もう 行きなさい

key: Obviously it's not like the boss cares either.
en: Obviously it's not like the boss cares either.
ja: どうせ ボスも 気にしていないもの

key: ASTER: But don't expect us to let you go so easily next time!
en: ASTER: But don't expect us to let you go so easily next time!
ja: アスター: だが 次はこう簡単に 逃がさないからな!

key: ECLIPSE: We'll be leaving now. But, hey?
en: ECLIPSE: We'll be leaving now. But, hey?
ja: エクリプス: わたしたちは行くわ。でも いい?

key: Just because you beat us, doesn't mean you won.
en: Just because you beat us, doesn't mean you won.
ja: わたしたちに勝ったからといって 勝ったわけではないのよ

key: Ta-ta.
en: Ta-ta.
ja: では ごきげんよう

key: VICTORIA: I guess that's that...
en: VICTORIA: I guess that's that...
ja: ヴィクトリア: とりあえず 一段落ですね……

key: VICTORIA: Don't worry, I'm not hurt or anything.
en: VICTORIA: Don't worry, I'm not hurt or anything.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 心配しないで けがはしていません

key: Both of them-- Borealis, and their leader-- treated me quite humanely.
en: Both of them-- Borealis, and their leader-- treated me quite humanely.
ja: 二人とも——ボレアリスも あのリーダーも わたしを丁寧に扱ってくれました

key: And now Borealis is dead?
en: And now Borealis is dead?
ja: それなのに ボレアリスは死んだ……?

key: Wasn't he on their side?
en: Wasn't he on their side?
ja: 彼は 味方だったのでは?
わたし——

key: I don't understand...
en: I don't understand...
ja: わけが わかりません……

key: All the leader did was talk to me-- about that gate up there.
en: All the leader did was talk to me-- about that gate up there.
ja: リーダーは わたしに話をしただけ——あの上の門のことを

key: And how, in order to start the Reborn League, Ame plastered all over some kind of holy site...
en: And how, in order to start the Reborn League, Ame plastered all over some kind of holy site...
ja: リボーンリーグを始めるために アメが聖地のようなものを 塗りつぶしたと……

key: It doesn't sound right, but maybe this is just some kind of propaganda?
en: It doesn't sound right, but maybe this is just some kind of propaganda?

key: I don't get it.
en: I don't get it.
ja: よく わかりません

key: But I'm not just going to stand by and let them do whatever they want.
en: But I'm not just going to stand by and let them do whatever they want.
ja: でも 好き勝手させて 黙って見ているつもりはありません

key: Before anything, let's get out of here.
en: Before anything, let's get out of here.
ja: まずは ここを出ましょう

key: I can probably find the way out myself, but do you want to go together?
en: I can probably find the way out myself, but do you want to go together?
ja: 出口は一人でも探せますが 一緒に行きますか?

key: VICTORIA: Sounds great!
en: VICTORIA: Sounds great!
ja: ヴィクトリア: いいですね!

key: I can't wait to get some air.
en: I can't wait to get some air.
ja: 早く 外の空気が吸いたいです

key: VICTORIA: Sure, no problem.
en: VICTORIA: Sure, no problem.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ええ 構いません

key: I'll wait for you outside.
en: I'll wait for you outside.
ja: 外で 待っています

key: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
en: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
ja: この　いわの　なかで　エネルギーが　かがやいている……

key: Do you want to mine the rock?
en: Do you want to mine the rock?
ja: いわを　さいくつしますか？

key: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
ja: 頑丈すぎて 壊すことも 動かすこともできない……

key: The rock base may hold more valuables.
en: The rock base may hold more valuables.
ja: 岩の土台には まだ お宝が眠っているかもしれない

key: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
en: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?

key: LIN: Open sesame.
en: LIN: Open sesame.
ja: リン: 開け ゴマ

key: LIN: You were a fool to come to me with those.
en: LIN: You were a fool to come to me with those.

key: LIN: But then, they were fools to entrust you with them.
en: LIN: But then, they were fools to entrust you with them.
ja: リン: もっとも それをあなたに託した者たちも 愚かでしたが

key: LIN: Let us proceed.
en: LIN: Let us proceed.
ja: リン: 参りましょう

key: Our final destination still awaits.
en: Our final destination still awaits.
ja: 最後の目的地が まだ待っています

key: LIN: And you are not excused.
en: LIN: And you are not excused.
ja: リン: あなたを 許した覚えはありません

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
